# Image to Video Shots

Turn one to six static product images into moving 3–6-second video shots: a verbatim PRODUCT LOCK (shape, colour, logo, material, accessories) in every prompt, one shot role per image, ready-to-paste image-to-video prompts in Chinese and English (camera move, action, lighting, duration, aspect, negative constraints) for any model you choose (Seedance, Kling, Veo, Runway, Hailuo, Wan), a shot table plus a storyboard.json fragment, and a local Ken Burns fallback for every shot so a finished video can still be rendered with the bundled ffmpeg pipeline — whose default voice-over sends narration lines to Microsoft's Edge TTS service, or runs fully offline with --tts none.
